outcome: Anterior wedging of the cervical vertebral bodies
Listhesis of C2-C3 or C3-C4 segment
cohort: 13 patients with clinical diagnosis of osteogenesis imperfecta type 5.
finding: Cervical kyphosis appears to be a common feature of osteogenesis imperfecta type 5, is not caused by vertebral body fractures, and may be present throughout life.
